description: Top-level MJML email template editor. Renders the core TmEditorShell (Header / Toolbar / Left + LeftRail / Canvas / Right / StatusBar / MobileActions) and owns NO layout of its own: the shell decides desktop (>=1200), tablet (768-1199) and mobile (<768) from the editor's own container, keeps docked panels on desktop AND tablet (at most one expanded) and presents the palette/inspector as a non-modal bottom sheet (default) or a Bloky | Canvas | Vlastnosti tablist on a phone. The command row is a core TmToolbar with Overflow=Menu and a Priority per action (Save is Pinned); the mobile header holds the primary Save and the host's ToolbarStart while ToolbarEnd and the long-tail commands move into the „⋮“ overflow, and the action bar carries only Undo/Redo/Preview/Validate. The host reports every save outcome through OnSave and the editor owns the dirty state (IsDirty/IsDirtyChanged), IsSaving, ReadOnly and the single-flight save queue; SaveAsync() is public for a TmNavigationGuard.OnSaveAndLeave wiring. A failed or conflicting save is shown as an alert in the status bar, so the host's reason is readable without hovering the badge.

parameters.name: ActiveMobilePanel
parameters.description: The panel the mobile layout shows, two-way with ActiveMobilePanelChanged. The editor switches it to Right when the user selects a block (the inspector is where that selection is edited), and a host may drive it too.

parameters.name: ActiveMobilePanelChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user picks another mobile tab, or when the editor follows a block selection.

parameters.name: AutoSave
parameters.description: Auto-save configuration; when enabled, edits are saved after a debounce interval.

parameters.name: Breakpoints
parameters.description: The two container widths that decide the layout. Null (default) uses new TmLayoutBreakpoints(768, 1200): below 768 the editor is a phone layout, from 1200 the full desktop chrome, in between the tablet layout.

parameters.name: CanvasImageLoading
parameters.description: Whether the WYSIWYG canvas may request the document's remote images from the AUTHOR's browser. The default is Load (the canvas is a preview and the sent email loads the same source anyway). Set Placeholder for privacy: an imported template can carry a per-recipient tracking pixel and the placeholder mode issues no request at all — it paints a framed box with the image's alt text.

parameters.name: Document
parameters.description: Gets or sets the edited document. Two-way bindable via DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: DocumentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the document changes (for @bind-Document).

parameters.name: FooterActions
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the preview dialog footer — for example "Send test email". The editor never sends anything itself; the host owns that action and its result.

parameters.name: ImageUpload
parameters.description: Client-side limits (Accept, MaxBytes) applied to a picked image before OnImageUpload is called. null uses the defaults (5 MB, images only).

parameters.name: InitialMode
parameters.description: The layout rendered before the shell's first measurement. Defaults to Desktop, so a desktop host never sees a wrong compact frame.

parameters.name: IsDirtyChanged
parameters.description: Raised when IsDirty changes — only on a transition, never on initialization and never for an edit that keeps the document dirty.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the editor renders. Auto (default) lets the shell measure the editor's own container (never the viewport) and follow its width; a forced value renders that mode without a DOM, which is how a host or a test pins a tablet or phone layout. Forwarded to TmEditorShell unchanged.

parameters.name: MobilePanelPresentation
parameters.description: How the two panels present on a mobile layout. Sheet (default) keeps the canvas visible with a bottom sheet — a Blocks | Properties tab strip inside it while both panels are open; Tabs is a full-region Blocks | Canvas | Properties tablist with no sheet.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Optional host image-upload handler: receives a picked file, returns the hosted URL.

parameters.name: OnSave
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests a save.

parameters.name: ItemEditingMode
parameters.description: How the items of a social / navbar / carousel / accordion block are edited, forwarded to the inspector: Inline (default) keeps the 2.9.x behaviour, Dialog edits one item at a time in a modal over a copy, so the document changes in one undo step.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Disables every editing path (toolbox, canvas drag&drop and inline actions, inspector inputs, import, undo/redo and the shortcuts that mutate the document) while keeping preview, validation and export available. SaveAsync returns a failed result without calling the host. The component never changes this value itself.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the shell's resolved layout changes (the container crossed a breakpoint, or the host forced another LayoutMode). The initial value is not a change. Never bind this to LayoutMode — that would pin the layout and stop the shell from measuring.

parameters.name: ShowSaveButton
parameters.description: Whether the Save button is rendered. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ShowSaveStatus
parameters.description: Whether the save-status badge is rendered. Defaults to true; the badge announces unsaved changes, the in-flight save, the relative time of the last confirmed save, a failure with the host's message and a conflict.

parameters.name: TimeProvider
parameters.description: Clock used for auto-save debouncing (overridable in tests).

parameters.name: ToolbarEnd
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the end of the command bar, before the save chrome.

parameters.name: ToolbarStart
parameters.description: Optional host actions rendered at the start of the command bar (back, title, …).

parameters.name: ToolboxCollapsed
parameters.description: Whether the blocks palette is collapsed. Maps 1:1 onto TmEditorShell.CollapsedPanels (EditorShellPanel.Left), so the collapsed palette is the shell's rail with icons instead of a hidden list; the palette's own collapse arrow is off (ShowCollapseToggle=false). The editor mirrors the state it is given and reports every toggle — including a rail the shell imposes on a tablet — through ToolboxCollapsedChanged (D10).

parameters.name: ToolboxCollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new state when the user collapses or expands the blocks palette. Bind it back into ToolboxCollapsed for a controlled palette; without a binding the palette toggles on its own (seeded from the parameter).

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables offered by the variable picker (merged with extracted ones).
